d.d: Turned away, contorted (of the face or body).
Dryly humorous; sardonic or ironic, usually in a way that suggests acknowledgement of a problem or difficult situation.
To twist or contort (the body, face, etc.).
In a wry or sarcastic manner; ironically.

d.x: Rachel smiled wryly at Bryan, clearly showing her discomfort after being dragged into an unwanted interaction with him.
